Container.Name: blackmatrix
Container.Overview:
Crosspoint router matrix for Blackmagic ATEM switchers and Videohubs — one grid across the fleet, with Videohub protocol emulation so hardware router panels drive it.
Note: Two reasons for host networking, both of which fail silently in bridge mode: the device scan sweeps the local /24s and would sweep Docker's bridge instead, and the Videohub emulation LISTENS on a port per switcher (9990 upward) for panels to connect to. Devices can still be added by IP without the scan.
This image is published from a private repository, so its GHCR package is private too. Run 'docker login ghcr.io' on the server before installing.
